description: This file is a platform-specific upgrade script for OpenWrt firmware on certain devices. It defines functions to check the firmware image and perform upgrades, with specific handling for various device models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image to ensure it is suitable for the device, verifying the U-Boot version string for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific firmware upgrade procedures based on the device model.
